affected_external_pr.title: DSAI-WP9: reconcile current main into G9A preparation branch

incident: A stale PR-number assumption caused C2P execution to target PR #649 while attempting to close a superseded C2P PR. GitHub revealed #649 was an already-closed DSAI PR. The PR was returned to CLOSED, but its original body was overwritten and could not be recovered from the GitHub issue-events endpoint.
smallest_lawful_resolution: Restore the original PR #649 body from an authoritative copy, or have the DSAI operator explicitly accept a replacement body. Do not resume C2P mutation until that cross-programme metadata ambiguity is resolved.
continuation_point: C2P2-WP1 branch build/c2p2-wp1-contracts-v3 from main 22c5ede9c6e7ccdeba26ea53e7a83890170b10dd; WP1 conformance artifacts are preserved; exact-head CI has not been run on v3.
rollback: No branch/history rollback is required. Preserve DSAI PR #649 as CLOSED and repair only its metadata body through an authoritative forward correction.
